home.title: Statistics for all your channels — in one place
home.subtitle: KnB Stats collects daily metrics of your own pages and channels on YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, Threads, TikTok and Telegram, and shows them on one clear dashboard.
home.readOnly: We request read-only access to statistics. The service never posts, deletes or changes anything in your accounts.
home.f1d: Followers, views, reach and engagement from every platform side by side, measured the same way.
home.f2d: Every morning at 05:00 Kyiv time the server collects fresh numbers. No manual exports.
home.f3d: Pick any dates and instantly see growth or decline versus the previous period.
home.f4d: Access tokens are stored only on the server, encrypted, and never reach the browser.
home.s1d: With Google or email — in a minute.
home.s2d: Click “Connect” and grant read-only access to statistics on the platform's own consent screen.
home.s3d: Data appears immediately, with up to 30–90 days of history, and is refreshed daily.
home.platformsText: Connect only pages and channels you own or manage.
home.shot3: Top posts with links to the originals
home.trustTitle: Your data stays under your control
home.t1: Disconnect a platform in one click — tokens and data are deleted immediately.
home.t2: We never sell your data or use it for advertising.
home.t3: Delete your account and all data in Settings at any time.
home.ctaBottomText: Free sign-in with Google or email.
